item.tib: gsas mkhar ting mur g.yu rtse'i snyen sgrub rtsa ba'i brgyud 'grel yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: ces te gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas man ngag gi yang khol gsang ba'i snying po don gyi brnag pa dra ba dmar nag ting mur bsnyen sgrub rtsa ba'i rgyud 'grel ba rgyu 'phrul dbang drag gnam lcags ngar ma thog chen 'bar ba drag tu 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi zhabs rdul gtsug gi nor bu ltar du khur zhing yongs 'dzin mkhas pa du ma zhig gi blo gros las cung zad tsam smin par byas pa/ bru yi btsun pa ga ri gyer shin gyi ngor sde snod 'dzin cing rigs sngags smra ba/ gshen gyi dge sbyong bsod nams blo gros rig pa thog 'phen ces bya ba la shin du dad pa'i blo gros dang ldan cing lung rigs smra ba'i btsun pa dad pa rgyal mtshan ces pas yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ kha ba can gyi ljongs/ ru bzhi'i mthil g.yas ru'i khrod yar chab kyi 'gram/ gdan sa chen po khams lhung dben sa kha yi gtsug lag khang chen por gsang ba sngags kyi lus yongs su rdzogs par gtan la phab ste sbyor ba re zhig rdzogs so/ gsang rgyud 'di yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du/ 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i 'byung dug phung po lha sku rig stobs su bsgyar cing*/ tig rnam kun gzigs bstan gsang ba sngags kyis yongs su bzung ste rab tu gnas nas 'og rig tu tsug ning gsas mkhar ting mur g.yu rtse'i rgyud 'grel 'di sa phyogs gang la'ang dpe dkon gshis gshen bstan sman ri'i sdom brtson dge bsam gtan nyi ma dang*/ dge bzod pa rgyal mtshan khu dbang zung nas brtson bskyed lhur len gyis/ sman ri'i sgrub khang dpe khrod nas zhal bshus pa'o//
